title: Impact of busulfan exposure stratification on transplant outcomes and immune reconstitution in children with severe aplastic anemia
excerpt: This study examines how stratifying busulfan drug exposure levels affects transplant success rates and immune system recovery in children undergoing hematopoietic stem cell transplantation for severe aplastic anemia. By categorizing patients based on their busulfan exposure during conditioning therapy, the research evaluates whether tailored dosing strategies can improve clinical outcomes and accelerate immune reconstitution. The findings may inform personalized conditioning approaches to optimize transplant efficacy while managing treatment-related toxicity in this pediatric population.

title: Improving Medication Safety in Chronic Kidney Disease Using Rule-Based and Artificial Intelligence-Based Clinical Decision Support Systems: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials

The study examines how these computational tools can enhance prescribing practices and reduce adverse drug events in this high-risk population.

title: Embrace Pain-A Randomized Controlled Trial of Online Acceptance and Commitment Therapy for Painful Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy in Cancer Survivors
